title: The Shepherd Who Looked Up
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who keeps looking until he finds, and tonight Amos gives a whole nation one word, seek. A boy with his cheek flat on the rug hunting a blue marble is exactly the kind of looking Amos meant.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because seekers keep looking until they find. In Scout’s world today: Scout lost his little blue marble under the couch. He looked and looked, cheek flat on the rug, until his fingers closed around it, and he sat up glowing. Just like Amos told the people to seek Heavenly Father, Scout learned that the ones who keep looking are the ones who find.
